name: Birka and Hovgården
description: Birka was a Viking trading town on Björkö, a small island in Lake Mälaren about 30 km west of Stockholm. At its peak, up to 1,000 people lived here, making silk, antler and iron goods and trading as far as the Muslim world. Across the water on Adelsö lies Hovgården, a royal estate. Today you can walk among the grave mounds and the old town site.
